claims.claim: Drift anchors markdown docs to source code using tree-sitter and git
claims.quote: Drift anchors your markdown specs to source code using tree-sitter and git

claims.claim: When anchored code changes, drift check catches it in CI via AST fingerprinting
claims.quote: When the anchored code changes, `drift check` catches it in CI via AST fingerprinting

claims.claim: Specs go stale quickly in fast-moving codebases
claims.quote: Specs go stale fast in a fast-moving codebase

claims.claim: Existing approaches focus on keeping code examples in sync, not prose description
claims.quote: all focus on keeping code examples in sync, not the prose that describes them

claims.claim: Using LLM for staleness check on every commit is expensive
claims.quote: burning tokens every commit to answer did this doc go stale is expensive

claims.claim: Drift supports syntax-aware comparison for 7 languages
claims.quote: The comparison is syntax-aware for all supported languages (TypeScript, Python, Rust, Go, Zig, Java)

claims.claim: For unsupported languages, drift falls back to raw content comparison
claims.quote: For unsupported languages, drift falls back to raw content comparison

claims.claim: Fiberplane uses Effect for code explicitness
claims.quote: we've wholly embraced tools like Effect, for its explicitness

claims.claim: Fiberplane uses ast-grep for structural linting
claims.quote: `ast-grep` for structural linting to enforce our code shape and rules

claims.claim: Drift parses code with tree-sitter and hashes normalized AST fingerprint
claims.quote: Drift parses the code with tree-sitter and hashes a normalized AST fingerprint

claims.claim: AST fingerprint includes node kinds and token text but not whitespace or position
claims.quote: node kinds + token text, no whitespace or position data

claims.claim: Agents are prolific code changers but bad at knowing what else their changes affect
claims.quote: Agents are prolific code changers but terrible at knowing what else their change affects

claims.claim: Drift CI gate helps catch when code changes require spec updates
claims.quote: you touched `AuthConfig`, now update the spec that describes it

claims.claim: drift link command stamps provenance automatically
claims.quote: You don't need to write provenance by hand. `drift link` stamps it automatically

claims.claim: Switching lockfile format to TOML reduced merge conflicts from 44% to 25%
claims.quote: Switching drift's lockfile to TOML cut the rate from ~44% to ~25%

claims.claim: Drift is open source on github.com/fiberplane/drift
claims.quote: Drift is open source — github.com/fiberplane/drift

claims.claim: Can install drift via curl script
claims.quote: curl -fsSL https://drift.fp.dev/install.sh | sh

claims.claim: Fiberplane drives fp.dev development with fp itself
claims.quote: we drive most of fp.dev development with fp itself

claims.claim: Article published 25 March 2026
claims.quote: 25 March 2026

claims.claim: Read time is 4 minutes
claims.quote: 4 min read
